b.x: A child on formula: the tin and the formula water are not here. Continuous medicine is what the doctor already prescribed, for 45 days. Cloudy water follows the water page, with no invented dose. This page does not dial.

In use, not counting the margin of oil and flour left over: about 186 thousand calories in the month. Divided by 30, near 6,200 calories a day for the four. It is the same plate as the week, quiet, indoors. It is not an escape hike and it is not a banquet. If the house saves oil, they still eat. What thawed in the first two days gets eaten first and is not in the count.

It is not a shower. It is not a valve flush. It is not baby formula. It is not food nobody eats. It is not a year of tins, nor a showroom generator, nor a weapon. It is 570 liters, 22 kilos of rice, 60 tins, real hygiene, and two cylinders. If the house has nowhere to keep the water, the count warns before Tuesday: the month does not live on the fourth floor. The week does. The rest is the name of the other street, on paper, and the leaving on the day the house water ends. With the whole family. Early. With no audience.
